title: F2 racer Rafael Camara to make F1 debut at Sao Paulo Grand Prix as Haas confirm Esteban Ocon will not return
paragraphs: Ferrari junior and Formula 2 standings leader Rafael Camara will drive for Haas at the upcoming Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with the team confirming Esteban Ocon will no longer compete for them this year. Over the Mexico City Grand Prix weekend, Ocon – who previously announced he would be departing Haas at the end of the season – was replaced by reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa . title: What time is the Formula 1 2026 Sao Paulo Grand Prix and how can I watch it?
paragraphs: The 2026 Formula 1 season heads to Sao Paulo next for the 20th race weekend of the campaign, with Kimi Antonelli set to arrive in Brazil as this year's World Champion. Third place last weekend in Mexico City was enough for the Italian to become the youngest World Champion in F1 history, but he will look to add to his nine wins from his championship-winning campaign this weekend.
